messages:
acme-integrations: Hi team — since the 02:05 UTC rollout our plugin chains started returning wrong results. The external fulfillment hook is getting called but payload's nested items array is missing. Example order id 8934. This is blocking checkout. cc @sam-support
sam-support: Sorry about that. Can you paste the failing request_id and a minimal reproducer? Also which endpoint (streaming vs regular) are you using?
acme-integrations: request_id: r-2147001201. We're using streaming=true with chunked tool calls (we rely on streaming partials). Minimal curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." \\
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","stream":true,"input":"Create order","tools":[{"name":"fulfill","args_schema":{"order":{"id":"string","items":"array"}}}],"payload":{"order":{"id":"8934","items":[{"sku":"X","qty":1}]}}}'
```
maria-eng: Noted. We rolled out request-normalizer v3 at 02:05 (changes to arg merging for streamed fragments). @deploy-bot can you confirm rollout percentage?
deploy-bot: request-normalizer v3 rolled to 100% at 02:05 UTC (canary -> full). :package:
sam-support: Thanks. @noah-ml @maria-eng any known interactions between stream prefix caching and fn-invoke arg assembly?
noah-ml: Short answer: yes, we optimized prefix/KV cache merging to dedupe tokens across fragments. I haven't seen it remove nested keys though. Can you share inference logs for that request_id?
acme-integrations: Paste from their logs (redacted) —
```
[2026-02-14T02:05:09Z] r-2147001201 recv fragment {"order":{"id":"8934"}}
[2026-02-14T02:05:10Z] r-2147001201 recv fragment {"order":{}}
[2026-02-14T02:05:11Z] invoking tool fulfill args={"order":{"id":"8934"}}  <-- items missing
```
sam-support: That looks like the second fragment overwrote the first due to a merge strategy bug. maria, can we reproduce in staging by sending two fragments where later fragment has empty placeholder?
maria-eng: Reproduced locally with the streaming test harness. The request-normalizer v3 uses a shallow merge for streamed arg fragments; empty objects win. Patch idea: make merge deep and ignore empty-object fragments for tool args.
phil-sre: For mitigation we can rollback request-normalizer to v2. I rolled canary 100% -> v2 at 02:20 and acme reports behavior restored. acme-integrations: can you confirm?
acme-integrations: Confirmed — after rollback the items array is present and checkout works. :white_check_mark:
sam-support: Next steps: 1) patch normalizer to do deep-merge/ignore-empty fragments (maria), 2) add unit test and streaming fn-call e2e (noah), 3) communicate RCA and offer credit (diane-product to draft), 4) monitor for other customers. I've opened ticket RWD-3179 and assigned. Any objections?
diane-product: Fine. Please add postmortem and timeline to the ticket.
sam-support: assigning owners — maria -> fix PR, noah -> tests, phil -> deploy rollback/runbook, sam -> customer comms. I'll follow up in RWD-3179. Thanks everyone.
